verses.original: וַנֵּ֜פֶן וַנִּסַּ֤ע הַמִּדְבָּ֙רָה֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ ס֔וּף יַם־ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י דִּבֶּ֥ר רַבִּֽים׃ס יָמִ֥ים וַנָּ֥סָב אֶת־ הַר־ שֵׂעִ֖יר
verses.transliteration: wan·nê·p̄en wan·nis·sa‘ ham·miḏ·bā·rāh de·reḵ sūp̄ yam- ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ê·lāy dib·ber rab·bîm yā·mîm wan·nā·sāḇ ’eṯ- har- śê·‘îr
verses.literal: Then we turned back and headed for the wilderness by way of the Red Sea as the LORD . . . had instructed me and for many days we wandered around - Mount Seir

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: At this time the LORD said to me . . .

verses.original: סֹ֖ב אֶת־ הַזֶּ֑ה הָהָ֣ר רַב־ לָכֶ֕ם פְּנ֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם צָפֹֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: sōḇ ’eṯ- haz·zeh hā·hār raḇ- lā·ḵem pə·nū lā·ḵem ṣā·p̄ō·nāh
verses.literal: You have been wandering around - this hill country long enough turn to the north

verses.original: וְאֶת־ צַ֣ו לֵאמֹר֒ הָעָם֮ אַתֶּ֣ם עֹֽבְרִ֗ים בִּגְבוּל֙ אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם בְּנֵי־ עֵשָׂ֔ו הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּשֵׂעִ֑יר וְיִֽירְא֣וּ מִכֶּ֔ם מְאֹֽד׃ וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ṣaw lê·mōr hā·‘ām ’at·tem ‘ō·ḇə·rîm biḡ·ḇūl ’ă·ḥê·ḵem bə·nê- ‘ê·śāw hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·śê·‘îr wə·yî·rə·’ū mik·kem mə·’ōḏ wə·niš·mar·tem
verses.literal: - and command . . . the people You will pass through the territory of your brothers the descendants of Esau who live in Seir They will be afraid of you so you must be very careful

verses.original: אַל־ תִּתְגָּר֣וּ בָ֔ם כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ אֶתֵּ֤ן לָכֶם֙ מֵֽאַרְצָ֔ם עַ֖ד מִדְרַ֣ךְ כַּף־ רָ֑גֶל כִּֽי־ נָתַ֖תִּי אֶת־ הַ֥ר שֵׂעִֽיר׃ לְעֵשָׂ֔ו יְרֻשָּׁ֣ה
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiṯ·gā·rū ḇām kî lō- ’et·tên lā·ḵem mê·’ar·ṣām ‘aḏ miḏ·raḵ kap̄- rā·ḡel kî- nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- har śê·‘îr lə·‘ê·śāw yə·ruš·šāh
verses.literal: Do not provoke them for I will not give you any of their land not even a footprint . . . . . . because I have given - Mount Seir to Esau as [his] possession

verses.original: תִּשְׁבְּר֧וּ מֵֽאִתָּ֛ם בַּכֶּ֖סֶף אֹ֣כֶל וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֑ם וְגַם־ תִּכְר֧וּ מֵאִתָּ֛ם בַּכֶּ֖סֶף מַ֜יִם וּשְׁתִיתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: tiš·bə·rū mê·’it·tām bak·ke·sep̄ ’ō·ḵel wa·’ă·ḵal·tem wə·ḡam- tiḵ·rū mê·’it·tām bak·ke·sep̄ ma·yim ū·šə·ṯî·ṯem
verses.literal: You are to pay them in silver for the food you eat and - - - the water you drink

verses.original: כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ בֵּֽרַכְךָ֗ בְּכֹל֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֔ךָ יָדַ֣ע לֶכְתְּךָ֔ אֶת־ הַזֶּ֑ה הַגָּדֹ֖ל הַמִּדְבָּ֥ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ זֶ֣ה׀ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה חָסַ֖רְתָּ לֹ֥א דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bê·raḵ·ḵā bə·ḵōl ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā yā·ḏa‘ leḵ·tə·ḵā ’eṯ- haz·zeh hag·gā·ḏōl ham·miḏ·bār Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ‘im·māḵ zeh ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh ḥā·sar·tā lō dā·ḇār
verses.literal: Indeed the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands He has watched over your journey - through this vast wilderness The LORD your God has been with you these forty years and you have lacked nothing . . .

verses.original: וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֞ר מֵאֵ֧ת אַחֵ֣ינוּ בְנֵי־ עֵשָׂ֗ו הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּשֵׂעִ֔יר וַנֵּ֙פֶן֙ הָֽעֲרָבָ֔ה מִדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ מֵאֵילַ֖ת וּמֵעֶצְיֹ֣ן גָּ֑בֶרס וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֔ר דֶּ֖רֶךְ מִדְבַּ֥ר מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wan·na·‘ă·ḇōr mê·’êṯ ’a·ḥê·nū ḇə·nê- ‘ê·śāw hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·śê·‘îr wan·nê·p̄en hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh mid·de·reḵ mê·’ê·laṯ ū·mê·‘eṣ·yōn gå̄·ḇɛ·rs wan·na·‘ă·ḇōr de·reḵ miḏ·bar mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: So we passed by . . . our brothers the descendants of Esau who live in Seir We turned away from the Arabah road which comes up from Elath vvv and Ezion-geber and traveled along the road of the Wilderness of Moab

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֗י אֶל־ תָּ֙צַר֙ אֶת־ מוֹאָ֔ב וְאַל־ תִּתְגָּ֥ר בָּ֖ם מִלְחָמָ֑ה כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ אֶתֵּ֨ן לְךָ֤ מֵֽאַרְצוֹ֙ יְרֻשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֣י נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־ עָ֖ר לִבְנֵי־ ל֔וֹט יְרֻשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ’el- tå̄·ṣar ’eṯ- mō·w·’āḇ wə·’al- tiṯ·gār bām mil·ḥā·māh kî lō- ’et·tên lə·ḵā mê·’ar·ṣōw yə·ruš·šāh kî nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- ‘ār liḇ·nê- lō·wṭ yə·ruš·šāh
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to me Do not harass - the Moabites [or] provoke them to war for I will not give you any of their land - because I have given - Ar to the descendants of Lot as [their] possession

verses.original: הָאֵמִ֥ים לְפָנִ֖ים יָ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֑הּ עַ֣ם גָּד֥וֹל וְרַ֛ב וָרָ֖ם כָּעֲנָקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ê·mîm lə·p̄ā·nîm yā·šə·ḇū ḇāh ‘am gā·ḏō·wl wə·raḇ wā·rām kā·‘ă·nā·qîm
verses.literal: The Emites used to live there a people great and many as tall as the Anakites

verses.original: כָּעֲנָקִ֑ים אַף־ הֵ֖ם יֵחָשְׁב֥וּ רְפָאִ֛ים וְהַמֹּ֣אָבִ֔ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם אֵמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kā·‘ă·nā·qîm ’ap̄- hêm yê·ḥā·šə·ḇū rə·p̄ā·’îm wə·ham·mō·’ā·ḇîm yiq·rə·’ū lā·hem ’ê·mîm
verses.literal: Like the Anakites they were also . . . regarded as Rephaim though the Moabites called them Emites

verses.original: הַחֹרִים֮ לְפָנִים֒ יָשְׁב֣וּ וּבְשֵׂעִ֞יר וּבְנֵ֧י עֵשָׂ֣ו יִֽירָשׁ֗וּם וַיַּשְׁמִידוּם֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ תַּחְתָּ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עָשָׂ֣ה לְאֶ֙רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֖ה נָתַ֥ן לָהֶֽם׃ יְרֻשָּׁת֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥō·rîm lə·p̄ā·nîm yā·šə·ḇū ū·ḇə·śê·‘îr ū·ḇə·nê ‘ê·śāw yî·rā·šūm way·yaš·mî·ḏūm mip·pə·nê·hem way·yê·šə·ḇū taḥ·tām ka·’ă·šer yiś·rā·’êl ‘ā·śāh lə·’e·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh nā·ṯan lā·hem yə·ruš·šā·ṯōw
verses.literal: The Horites used to live in Seir but the descendants of Esau drove them out They destroyed [the Horites] from before them and settled in their place just as Israel did in the land that the LORD gave them as their possession

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה קֻ֛מוּ וְעִבְר֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־ נַ֣חַל זָ֑רֶד וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־ נַ֥חַל זָֽרֶד׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh qu·mū wə·‘iḇ·rū lā·ḵem ’eṯ- na·ḥal zā·reḏ wan·na·‘ă·ḇōr ’eṯ- na·ḥal zā·reḏ
verses.literal: Now arise and cross over - the Brook of Zered So we crossed over - the Brook of Zered

verses.original: וְהַיָּמִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר־ הָלַ֣כְנוּ׀ מִקָּדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֗עַ עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר־ עָבַ֙רְנוּ֙ אֶת־ נַ֣חַל זֶ֔רֶד שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה עַד־ כָּל־ הַדּ֜וֹר הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ אַנְשֵׁ֤י תֹּ֨ם מִקֶּ֣רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer- hā·laḵ·nū miq·qā·ḏêš bar·nê·a‘ ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·ḇar·nū ’eṯ- na·ḥal ze·reḏ šə·lō·šîm ū·šə·mō·neh šā·nāh ‘aḏ- kāl- had·dō·wr ham·mil·ḥā·māh ’an·šê tōm miq·qe·reḇ ham·ma·ḥă·neh ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh niš·ba‘ lā·hem
verses.literal: The time - we spent traveling from Kadesh-barnea until - we crossed over - the Brook of Zered was thirty-eight . . . years until that entire generation of fighting men had perished from the camp as the LORD had sworn to them

verses.original: וְגַ֤ם יְהוָה֙ יַד־ הָ֣יְתָה בָּ֔ם לְהֻמָּ֖ם מִקֶּ֣רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam Yah·weh yaḏ- hā·yə·ṯāh bām lə·hum·mām miq·qe·reḇ ham·ma·ḥă·neh ‘aḏ tum·mām
verses.literal: Indeed the LORD’s hand was against them to eliminate them from the camp until they had all perished

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י כַאֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֜מּוּ כָּל־ הַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה אַנְשֵׁ֧י מִקֶּ֥רֶב הָעָֽם׃ס לָמ֖וּת
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵa·’ă·šer- tam·mū kāl- ham·mil·ḥā·māh ’an·šê miq·qe·reḇ hā·‘ām lā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Now when . . . all the fighting men among the people had died

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: the LORD said to me . . .

verses.original: הַיּ֛וֹם אֶת־ אַתָּ֨ה עֹבֵ֥ר גְּב֥וּל מוֹאָ֖ב אֶת־ עָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yō·wm ’eṯ- ’at·tāh ‘ō·ḇêr gə·ḇūl mō·w·’āḇ ’eṯ- ‘ār
verses.literal: Today - you are going to cross the border of Moab - at Ar

verses.original: וְקָרַבְתָּ֗ מ֚וּל בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן אַל־ תְּצֻרֵ֖ם וְאַל־ תִּתְגָּ֣ר בָּ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹֽא־ אֶ֠תֵּן לְךָ֙ מֵאֶ֨רֶץ בְּנֵי־ עַמּ֤וֹן יְרֻשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י נְתַתִּ֥יהָ לִבְנֵי־ ל֖וֹט יְרֻשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qā·raḇ·tā mūl bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ’al- tə·ṣu·rêm wə·’al- tiṯ·gār bām kî lō- ’et·tên lə·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ bə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn yə·ruš·šāh kî nə·ṯat·tî·hā liḇ·nê- lō·wṭ yə·ruš·šāh
verses.literal: But when you get close to the Ammonites . . . do not harass them . . . or provoke them for I will not give you any of the land of the Ammonites . . . - - I have given it to the descendants of Lot as [their] possession

verses.original: אַף־ הִ֑וא תֵּחָשֵׁ֖ב אֶֽרֶץ־ רְפָאִ֥ים רְפָאִ֤ים יָֽשְׁבוּ־ בָהּ֙ לְפָנִ֔ים וְהָֽעַמֹּנִ֔ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם זַמְזֻמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- hî tê·ḥā·šêḇ ’e·reṣ- rə·p̄ā·’îm rə·p̄ā·’îm yā·šə·ḇū- ḇāh lə·p̄ā·nîm wə·hā·‘am·mō·nîm yiq·rə·’ū lā·hem zam·zum·mîm
verses.literal: That too was regarded as the land of the Rephaim [who] used to live there . . . though the Ammonites called them Zamzummites

verses.original: עַ֣ם גָּד֥וֹל וְרַ֛ב וָרָ֖ם כָּעֲנָקִ֑ים יְהוָה֙ וַיַּשְׁמִידֵ֤ם מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּירָשֻׁ֖ם וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am gā·ḏō·wl wə·raḇ wā·rām kā·‘ă·nā·qîm Yah·weh way·yaš·mî·ḏêm mip·pə·nê·hem way·yî·rā·šum way·yê·šə·ḇū ṯaḥ·tām
verses.literal: [They were] a people great and many as tall as the Anakites But the LORD destroyed them from before [the Ammonites] who drove them out and settled in their place

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לִבְנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֔ו הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּשֵׂעִ֑יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִשְׁמִ֤יד אֶת־ הַחֹרִי֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּֽירָשֻׁם֙ וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ תַחְתָּ֔ם עַ֖ד הַזֶּֽה׃ הַיּ֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh liḇ·nê ‘ê·śāw hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·śê·‘îr ’ă·šer hiš·mîḏ ’eṯ- ha·ḥō·rî mip·pə·nê·hem way·yî·rā·šum way·yê·šə·ḇū ṯaḥ·tām ‘aḏ haz·zeh hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: just as He had done for the descendants of Esau who lived in Seir when He destroyed - the Horites from before them They drove them out and have lived in their place to this day

verses.original: וְהָֽעַוִּ֛ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בַּחֲצֵרִ֖ים עַד־ עַזָּ֑ה הִשְׁמִידֻ֖ם כַּפְתֹּרִים֙ הַיֹּצְאִ֣ים מִכַּפְתּ֔וֹר וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘aw·wîm hay·yō·šə·ḇîm ba·ḥă·ṣê·rîm ‘aḏ- ‘az·zāh hiš·mî·ḏum kap̄·tō·rîm hay·yō·ṣə·’îm mik·kap̄·tō·wr way·yê·šə·ḇū ṯaḥ·tām
verses.literal: And the Avvim who lived in villages as far as Gaza were destroyed by the Caphtorites who came out of Caphtor and settled in their place

verses.original: ק֣וּמוּ סְּע֗וּ וְעִבְרוּ֮ אֶת־ אַרְנֹן֒ נַ֣חַל רְאֵ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּי בְ֠יָדְךָ סִיחֹ֨ן הָֽאֱמֹרִ֛י וְאֶת־ מֶֽלֶךְ־ חֶשְׁבּ֧וֹן אַרְצ֖וֹ אֶת־ הָחֵ֣ל רָ֑שׁ וְהִתְגָּ֥ר בּ֖וֹ מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qū·mū sə·‘ū wə·‘iḇ·rū ’eṯ- ’ar·nōn na·ḥal rə·’êh nā·ṯat·tî ḇə·yā·ḏə·ḵā sî·ḥōn hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·’eṯ- me·leḵ- ḥeš·bō·wn ’ar·ṣōw ’eṯ- hā·ḥêl rāš wə·hiṯ·gār bōw mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Arise set out and cross - the Arnon Valley See I have delivered into your hand Sihon the Amorite - king of Heshbon and his land - Begin to take possession of it and engage him in battle

verses.original: הַזֶּ֗ה הַיּ֣וֹם אָחֵל֙ תֵּ֤ת פַּחְדְּךָ֙ וְיִרְאָ֣תְךָ֔ עַל־ כָּל־ פְּנֵי֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁמְעוּן֙ שִׁמְעֲךָ֔ וְרָגְז֥וּ וְחָל֖וּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: haz·zeh hay·yō·wm ’ā·ḥêl têṯ paḥ·də·ḵā wə·yir·’ā·ṯə·ḵā ‘al- kāl- pə·nê hā·‘am·mîm ta·ḥaṯ haš·šā·mā·yim ’ă·šer yiš·mə·‘ūn šim·‘ă·ḵā wə·rā·ḡə·zū wə·ḥā·lū mip·pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: This very day I will begin to put the dread and fear of you upon all vvv the nations under heaven - They will hear the reports of you and tremble in anguish because of you

verses.original: מִמִּדְבַּ֣ר קְדֵמ֔וֹת וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכִים֙ דִּבְרֵ֥י שָׁל֖וֹם אֶל־ סִיח֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: mim·miḏ·bar qə·ḏê·mō·wṯ wā·’eš·laḥ mal·’ā·ḵîm diḇ·rê šā·lō·wm ’el- sî·ḥō·wn me·leḵ ḥeš·bō·wn lê·mōr
verses.literal: So from the Wilderness of Kedemoth I sent messengers with an offer of peace to Sihon king of Heshbon saying

verses.original: אֶעְבְּרָ֣ה בְאַרְצֶ֔ךָ בַּדֶּ֥רֶךְ בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֵלֵ֑ךְ לֹ֥א אָס֖וּר יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול׃
verses.transliteration: ’e‘·bə·rāh ḇə·’ar·ṣe·ḵā bad·de·reḵ bad·de·reḵ ’ê·lêḵ lō ’ā·sūr yā·mîn ū·śə·mō·wl
verses.literal: Let us pass through your land we will stay on the main road . . . . . . We will not turn to the right or to the left

verses.original: תַּשְׁבִּרֵ֙נִי֙ אֹ֣כֶל בַּכֶּ֤סֶף וְאָכַ֔לְתִּי תִּתֶּן־ לִ֖י וּמַ֛יִם וְשָׁתִ֑יתִי בַּכֶּ֥סֶף רַ֖ק אֶעְבְּרָ֥ה בְרַגְלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: taš·bi·rê·nî ’ō·ḵel bak·ke·sep̄ wə·’ā·ḵal·tî tit·ten- lî ū·ma·yim wə·šā·ṯî·ṯî bak·ke·sep̄ raq ’e‘·bə·rāh ḇə·raḡ·lāy
verses.literal: You can sell us food - to eat [and] water to drink in exchange for silver Only let us pass through on foot

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר בְּנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֗ו הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּשֵׂעִ֔יר וְהַמּ֣וֹאָבִ֔ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּעָ֑ר עָֽשׂוּ־ לִ֜י עַ֤ד אֲשֶֽׁר־ אֶֽעֱבֹר֙ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer bə·nê ‘ê·śāw hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·śê·‘îr wə·ham·mō·w·’ā·ḇîm hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·‘ār ‘ā·śū- lî ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- ’e·‘ĕ·ḇōr ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū nō·ṯên lā·nū
verses.literal: just as the descendants of Esau who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Ar did for us until - we cross - the Jordan into the land that the LORD our God is giving us

verses.original: סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן אָבָ֗ה וְלֹ֣א הַעֲבִרֵ֖נוּ בּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֶת־ רוּח֗וֹ הִקְשָׁה֩ לְבָב֔וֹ וְאִמֵּץ֙ אֶת־ לְמַ֛עַן תִּתּ֥וֹ בְיָדְךָ֖ הַזֶּֽה׃ס כַּיּ֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: sî·ḥōn me·leḵ ḥeš·bō·wn ’ā·ḇāh wə·lō ha·‘ă·ḇi·rê·nū bōw kî- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’eṯ- rū·ḥōw hiq·šāh lə·ḇā·ḇōw wə·’im·mêṣ ’eṯ- lə·ma·‘an tit·tōw ḇə·yā·ḏə·ḵā haz·zeh kay·yō·wm
verses.literal: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass through for the LORD your God - had made his spirit stubborn and his heart obstinate - that He might deliver him into your hand as is the case this day

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַ֔י רְאֵ֗ה הַֽחִלֹּ֙תִי֙ תֵּ֣ת סִיחֹ֖ן וְאֶת־ אַרְצ֑וֹ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ אֶת־ הָחֵ֣ל רָ֔שׁ לָרֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת־ אַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lay rə·’êh ha·ḥil·lō·ṯî têṯ sî·ḥōn wə·’eṯ- ’ar·ṣōw lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ’eṯ- hā·ḥêl rāš lā·re·šeṯ ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣōw
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to me See I have begun to deliver Sihon - and his land over to you Now begin to conquer and possess - his land

verses.original: סִיחֹ֨ן ה֧וּא וְכָל־ עַמּ֛וֹ וַיֵּצֵא֩ לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה לִקְרָאתֵ֜נוּ יָֽהְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: sî·ḥōn hū wə·ḵāl ‘am·mōw way·yê·ṣê lam·mil·ḥā·māh liq·rā·ṯê·nū yā·hə·ṣāh
verses.literal: So Sihon - and his whole army came out for battle against us at Jahaz

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֛הוּ לְפָנֵ֑ינוּ וַנַּ֥ךְ אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־ בְּנוֹ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū way·yit·tə·nê·hū lə·p̄ā·nê·nū wan·naḵ ’ō·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- bə·nō wə·’eṯ- kāl- ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: And the LORD our God delivered him over to us and we defeated him - - and his sons - and his whole army

verses.original: הַהִ֔וא בָּעֵ֣ת וַנִּלְכֹּ֤ד אֶת־ כָּל־ עָרָיו֙ וַֽנַּחֲרֵם֙ אֶת־ מְתִ֔ם כָּל־ עִ֣יר וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְהַטָּ֑ף הִשְׁאַ֖רְנוּ לֹ֥א שָׂרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hi·w bā·‘êṯ wan·nil·kōḏ ’eṯ- kāl- ‘ā·rāw wan·na·ḥă·rêm ’eṯ- mə·ṯim kāl- ‘îr wə·han·nā·šîm wə·haṭ·ṭāp̄ hiš·’ar·nū lō śā·rîḏ
verses.literal: At that time we captured - all his cities and devoted to destruction - the people of every city including women and children We left no survivors

verses.original: רַ֥ק בָּזַ֣זְנוּ לָ֑נוּ הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה וּשְׁלַ֥ל הֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכָֽדְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: raq bā·zaz·nū lā·nū hab·bə·hê·māh ū·šə·lal he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer lā·ḵā·ḏə·nū
verses.literal: We carried off for ourselves only the livestock and the plunder from the cities - we captured

verses.original: מֵֽעֲרֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־ שְׂפַת־ אַרְנֹ֜ן נַ֨חַל וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּנַּ֙חַל֙ וְעַד־ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד לֹ֤א קִרְיָ֔ה הָֽיְתָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂגְבָ֖ה מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ נָתַ֛ן לְפָנֵֽינוּ׃ הַכֹּ֕ל
verses.transliteration: mê·‘ă·rō·‘êr ’ă·šer ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ- ’ar·nōn na·ḥal wə·hā·‘îr ’ă·šer ban·na·ḥal wə·‘aḏ- hag·gil·‘āḏ lō qir·yāh hā·yə·ṯāh ’ă·šer śā·ḡə·ḇāh mim·men·nū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū nā·ṯan lə·p̄ā·nê·nū hak·kōl
verses.literal: From Aroer - on the rim of the Arnon Valley along with the city - in the valley even as far as Gilead not one city [had walls] - too high for us - The LORD our God gave us all of them

verses.original: רַ֛ק אֶל־ לֹ֣א קָרָ֑בְתָּ אֶ֥רֶץ בְּנֵי־ עַמּ֖וֹן כָּל־ יַ֞ד יַבֹּק֙ נַ֤חַל וְעָרֵ֣י הָהָ֔ר וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ צִוָּ֖ה
verses.transliteration: raq ’el- lō qā·rā·ḇə·tā ’e·reṣ bə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn kāl- yaḏ yab·bōq na·ḥal wə·‘ā·rê hā·hār wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ṣiw·wāh
verses.literal: But . . . you did not go near the land of the Ammonites . . . or [the land] along the banks of the Jabbok River or the cities of the hill country or any place that the LORD our God had forbidden
